pages.seoDescription: FixList is on-demand handyman service — mounting, assembly, smart-home installs and repairs at flat rates. Book a vetted, insured pro online in minutes.

On-demand handymen for busy homeowners and renters. Pick the task, choose a time, and a vetted pro shows up ready to work — at a flat hourly rate you see before you book.

A background-checked, insured pro turns up on time with the tools, does the work, cleans up, and you pay through the app. Done.

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who FixList is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A tidy tool bag and cordless drill on a kitchen counter

children: FixList started with a simple frustration: getting small home jobs done meant phone tag, no-shows and a price you only heard after the work was over. So we built the opposite.

Now you book online in minutes, see the flat rate before you commit, and get a vetted, insured pro at your door — often the same day. No quotes to chase, no cash to dig up, no wondering who’s showing up.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every pro is background-checked, insured and reviewed by real customers. We stand behind the work, not just the booking.
Flat rates per task, quoted before you book and charged in the app. What you’re quoted is what you pay.
Live availability with evening and weekend slots, and free rescheduling — so a fix fits around your life, not the other way round.
